script.base: Spread and total were not saved, so this script is inferred only from form, not from who the book expects to lead or how many points. Both run games are inefficient (Judkins 3.06 YPC on 47 carries, Hall 2.10 YPC on 29 carries), so the base flow is a competitive pass-lean game. Both defenses bleed only the middle (NYJ 9.26 YPA on 35 att, CLE 9.47 YPA on 30 att), and NYJ has allowed just 9 passes of 20+ on 136 att, so the live area is intermediate targets (Fannin 20 tgt/132 yds, Sadiq 15 tgt/122 yds), not bombs.
script.flip1: One team leads by two scores by halftime and runs the clock. CLE would lean on Judkins (47 carries in L3) plus Watson (19 carries), and Fannin/Boston/Concepcion yards stall. If NYJ is the trailer, Hall's 2.10 YPC run gets abandoned and Wilson (25 tgt, 238 air yds) can monopolize targets, which can leave Sadiq short.
script.flip2: NYJ's 37% blitz gets home. CLE QB EPA is 0.14 vs blitz (n=51) vs 0.15 unblitzed, so structure holds, but the throw mix flips short: Fannin and Judkins checkdowns up, Boston's 14.2 aDOT down. A weather slog is the other flip, but weather was not saved.

Boston (269 air yds, 14.2 aDOT) overlaps NYJ's strength, so he is not an edge. Sadiq (15 tgt, 97 air yds, 6.5 aDOT, 40.7 rec yds/game) overlaps CLE's middle 9.47 YPA. Wilson's 63.7 yds/game sits under 68.5, so no overlap edge at that number.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both unders cashed because the 3-game rates were spikes we could not split, and the game never became the middle-of-the-field script. Fannin at 6.7 targets times NYJ's outside 5.1-5.8 YPA is about 34-39, so if he is not actually the middle target the 35.0 line is a coin flip, and a CLE lead lets Judkins (47 carries in L3) and Watson (19 carries) grind him out. Sadiq's 8.1 yards per target can regress, and Wilson (25 targets, 238 air yds) plus Hall's 28.7 receiving yards can steal the checkdowns down to 3 targets and about 24 yards. Shared kill is a blowout or an unsaved weather slog. The Allen 71.5 and Boston 47.5 numbers were the trap: big gaps versus recent averages with either a coin-flip price or a defense that does not allow the play type.
slip_story: One story only: competitive pass-lean, both offenses attack the middle because that is the only soft zone on either defense. Stack is Fannin recyds over 35 with Sadiq recyds over 30. They win together if the game stays competitive. Do not add Boston recyds over (needs explosives NYJ has not allowed), a Judkins rush over, or any total (total not saved).
